title: Release v0.3.1
body:
Patch release documenting package restructure from `@object-ui/plugin-object` to `@object-ui/views`.

## Changes

- Bumped all packages: `0.3.0` → `0.3.1`
- Generated package CHANGELOGs via changesets
- Updated root CHANGELOG with v0.3.1 entry (2026-01-27)

## Package Versions

All 24 monorepo packages now at `0.3.1`:
- Core: `@object-ui/{core,react,components,types,fields}`
- Plugins: `@object-ui/plugin-{aggrid,calendar,charts,chatbot,dashboard,editor,form,gantt,grid,kanban,map,markdown,timeline,view}`
- Tools: `@object-ui/{cli,runner,layout,data-objectstack,vscode-extension}`
